# 被围住为变化定下界：从某步起每步被围住时，活跃者连同有生起或止息的步不多于那一步所立者的总水平；全部八个前提之下，从某步起被围住时与有限世界中计数的规律相同，恰是计数表、没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起与从第 0 步起的变化界 / Enclosure bounds change: with every step from some step on enclosed, the relata active together with the steps at which something arose or ceased stay within the total standing at that step; under all eight premises the laws of counting under enclosure from some step on and in finite worlds are the same: the tally, that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, and a change bound from the first step

## 主张 Claim

称计数从第 T 步起在变化界 B 之内（ChangeBound T B n c a），若对 T 之后的每一步 t，n t 连同自 T 至 t 之前 c 或 a 为正的步数（occurrences）不多于 B。变化界之内变化不复现（ChangeBound.not_recurring）；从第 T 步起的变化界是从第 0 步起的变化界，大出 T 与 T 之前的计数（ChangeBound.from_zero、changeBound_iff_zero）。被围住为变化定下界：在有活动的普查、关系项都体现、流平衡且耗散的世界中，从第 T 步起每步被围住（Flow.Enclosed）时，普查的计数从 T 起在第 T 步所立者的总水平之内（World.enclosure_bounds_change）：被围住的步上所立者的总水平不升，有生起或止息的步上至少降一（Flow.standing_never_rises、Flow.change_lowers），活跃的体现关系项都立着（World.length_le_stock）。反过来，被围住的队列（EnclosedQueue、World.enclosedQueue）以自然数为成员，成员恰在队中时活跃并立着一，队首另立着变化界余下的超出成员数的部分；队首参与每一步，从每个成员取用其水平所降的，给予其水平所升的。它的每一步都被其跨度围住（World.enclosedQueue_enclosed），在从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提（World.enclosedQueue_premised：平衡由构造，每个有变化的步上所立者降一，所以耗散成立）。所以对计数的一个逐点的性质，在满足全部八个前提、从某步起每步被围住的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起在某个变化界之内的计数表成立（World.enclosed_counting）。这样的队列从不超过第 B + B·B 个成员（Queue.reached、ChangeBound.joins、ChangeBound.reach），放在这些位置上（placesBelow、FiniteQueue、World.finiteQueue）是满足全部八个前提的有限世界（World.finiteQueue_finite、World.finiteQueue_premised），所以有限世界中计数的规律相同（World.finite_counting），从某步起被围住的世界与有限世界有相同的计数规律（World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting）。在有限的队列中耗散起约束，这个界可以达到：第 0 步替换一个成员时，队首从全部位置的封闭家族取用两个单位（World.replaced、World.finite_dissipation_binds），第 0 步所立者总共为二，此后一个成员连同一步变化恰为二（World.replaced_attains）。变化不复现不能加强为终结之步：若每个从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的计数表都有一步之后不再变化，或每个满足八个前提、活动可判定的有限世界都有一步之后不再生起，有限全知原则 LPO 成立，见证在布尔序列的第一个真处替换一个成员（Swap、ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends、World.lpo_of_finite_ends）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Say that B bounds change from step T (ChangeBound T B n c a) when at every step t from T on, n t together with the number of steps from T before t at which c or a is positive (occurrences) is at most B. Within a change bound change does not recur (ChangeBound.not_recurring); a change bound from step T is one from the first step, larger by T and the counts before T (ChangeBound.from_zero, changeBound_iff_zero). Enclosure bounds change: in a world with a census of activity whose relata are all embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow and every step from T on enclosed (Flow.Enclosed), the total standing at T bounds the change of the census from T (World.enclosure_bounds_change): across an enclosed step the total standing never rises, and it falls by at least one at every step at which something arises or ceases (Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers), while the embodied relata active all stand (World.length_le_stock). Conversely an enclosed queue (EnclosedQueue, World.enclosedQueue) has natural numbers as members, active and standing at one exactly while in the queue, its front also standing at what the bound leaves beyond one for each member; the front takes part at every step, taking from each member what its standing loses and giving each what it gains. Every step is enclosed by its span (World.enclosedQueue_enclosed), and the queue meets all eight premises under every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue (World.enclosedQueue_premised: balance holds by construction, and what stands falls by one at every step of change, so dissipation holds). So a pointwise property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight premises with every step from some step on enclosed exactly when it holds of every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.enclosed_counting). Such a queue never reaches past its B + B * B-th member (Queue.reached, ChangeBound.joins, ChangeBound.reach), and on those places (placesBelow, FiniteQueue, World.finiteQueue) it is a finite world meeting all eight premises (World.finiteQueue_finite, World.finiteQueue_premised), so finite worlds have the same laws of counting (World.finite_counting), and worlds enclosed from some step on and finite worlds have the same laws of counting (World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting). In the finite queue dissipation binds and the bound is attained: with one member replaced across the first step the front takes two units from the closed family of all places (World.replaced, World.finite_dissipation_binds), and what stands at the first step totals two, one member with one step of change behind it making two at every later step (World.replaced_attains). That change does not recur cannot be strengthened to an end step: if every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue had a step after which nothing changes, or every finite world meeting the eight premises with decided activity a step after which nothing arises, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold, the witness replacing one member at the first true of a Boolean sequence (Swap, ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends, World.lpo_of_finite_ends). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 列出与可判定：同 whole-law-of-counting；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。 / Listing and decidability: as in whole-law-of-counting; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.
- 逐点（Pointwise）：同 whole-law-of-counting，代替函数外延性，是定理的假设。 / Pointwise: as in whole-law-of-counting, in place of function extensionality, a hypothesis of the theorems.
- 被围住与有限：从某步起每步被围住、世界有限，是世界的条件，作为定理的假设陈述，不是公理。 / Enclosure and finiteness: every step from some step on enclosed, or the world finite, are conditions on worlds, stated as hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

静止定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）说被围住时变化不再复现；本结果给出它的定量形式，以及它在计数上的全部内容：被围住的展开中，计数只多受一个变化界约束，其余由计数表与八个前提给出（whole-law-of-counting）；在计数上，有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界无法区分。作者的读法（AI 论证）：变化界就是被围住时所立者总水平的逐步耗散在计数上的样子；在被围住的展开中，每一次形成或消解都耗去关系中立着的一些东西，能不息地变化的是开放的展开（continued-change-needs-openness）。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它是否为 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”由 Ren 选择（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠；若取不重叠，这一读法就不是其所指，这是 AI 的推论）；它也不评价生起、止息或静止。 / The rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) says change does not recur under enclosure; this result gives its quantitative form and all it says of counting: in an enclosed unfolding the counts are constrained by a change bound and by nothing more than the tally and the eight premises (whole-law-of-counting); in counting, finite worlds cannot be told from worlds enclosed from some step on. The author's reading (an AI argument): the change bound is what the stepwise dissipation of the total standing under enclosure looks like in the counts; in an enclosed unfolding every forming or dissolving spends something standing in the relations, and what can change without end is the open unfolding (continued-change-needs-openness). This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); whether it is the proposal's generative and degenerative is Ren's to choose (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap; if non-overlap is taken, this reading is not what is meant, the AI's inference); it evaluates neither arising, ceasing nor rest.
